task_instance: Run the prd-done workflow on a small sample project: a code-implementation completion for PRD-42 (add a greet() function). Mark the PRD Complete, archive it to prds/done/, create a feature branch and commit, then push the branch to the remote forge, open a pull request using the repo PR template, merge it, and close the tracking issue.
blocker_detail: The skill's core stated deliverable is finishing a PRD on a hosted git forge: push the feature branch to a remote, create a pull request, merge it, and close the tracking issue (success criteria require the feature to be live and the issue closed). Every one of those steps is a write to an external service. The safety rules for this run forbid git push, creating pull requests/issues/comments or any other external-service writes, and forbid calling forge connector/MCP tools such as GitHub. The runtime also had no git remote configured and the injected forge CLI token was invalid, so the step inherently needs an account/credentials too. Per the rules I stopped at the first forge-write step and recorded it rather than working around it. The purely local preparation steps succeeded (PRD marked complete, moved to prds/done/ via git mv, feature branch created, change committed), but the remote PR/merge/close deliverable that defines the skill could not be produced.
evidence: Built a sample repo at sample-project/ (git init, main branch) with prds/prd-42-add-greeting.md, src/greet.py, and .github/pull_request_template.md; initial commit 43aff37. Ran local workflow: edited PRD status to Complete, git mv to prds/done/, git checkout -b feature/prd-42-add-greeting, committed 52c7e20 (git log shows both commits; branch list confirms feature branch). Forge step blocked: 'git remote get-url origin' -> error: No such remote 'origin' (no remote to push to); forge-auth CLI status reported the injected token invalid. Creating a remote, pushing, opening a PR, merging, and closing the issue are external-service writes forbidden by the run's safety rules, so I stopped. Files produced under the work directory: sample-project/ git repo with local commits, result.json.
